name: web-minimal-fashion-product-detail-page-with-reviews
title: Minimal fashion PDP with pill size selector, huge rating numeral and rounded photo cards
whatItIs: A white page with a centred logo and pill filters. A large rounded photo of a hoodie model with thumbnails sits left; on the right title, price, delivery timer, round size pills, wide black Add to Cart with a heart button, and accordions for description and shipping. Below: a giant '4,5' rating with bars, a review card, and 'You might also like' cards with rounded photos, stars and discounts.
whatItMeans: Clean, contemporary and trustworthy; rounded elements and neutral colour keep focus on the clothes.
techniques: Use fully rounded pills for filters, sizes and buttons.
Display the rating as a giant numeral next to thin bar rows.
Set thumbnails inside the main image rounded frame.
Use rounded product cards with small discount chips.

vocabulary.definition: A rounded selector for a product size.
A list of bars showing the count of each star rating.
Small images placed inside the main image frame.
A small pink or red tag showing a percentage off.
